messages:
cassandra: Heads up — multiple customers reporting blank graphs in Console since ~00:10 UTC. Looks like the analytics API is returning 500s for a lot of panel queries. Seeing this in Sentry and from user reports.

carlos: Confirmed from support side. Customer julie@acme says all their dashboard tiles are empty. They pasted a curl that returns 500.

julie: repro steps I used: 1) open Console -> project -> dashboards 2) click Sales Overview 3) panels show spinner then blank. I tried refresh, same. curl below: 

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" "https://analytics.api.redwood/v1/query?panel_id=9876"
# response: HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
{"error":"internal server error"}
```

anna: Thanks for the repro, Julie. I'm seeing a surge in errors on the analytics query executor around 00:08 UTC. Error pattern looks like OOM/failed-gc on the backend aggregator pods.

simon: Oncall jumping in. Any recent deployments or retention jobs around midnight?

cassandra: We rolled the nightly retention/backfill last night (timestamp-based TTL compaction) at 00:05 UTC across analytics clusters. I flagged it as low-risk.

anna: That lines up. The retention job triggers large scan/merge queries that appear to push aggregator memory usage up and trigger 500s for user queries. We're seeing KV cache thrashing too.

infra-bot: [deploy-bot] Retention-job v2.1 deployed to analytics-cluster-3 at 00:05 UTC by cassandra.

simon: Temp mitigation: can we throttle or pause the retention job? If it was deployed by ops, can we revert the job now to reduce pressure?

cassandra: I'll pause the nightly job. Doing: 
```
kubectl scale cronjob retention-job -n analytics --replicas=0
```

carlos: Noted — letting affected customers know we have a mitigation in progress.

anna: Pausing helped — error rate dropped by 80% within 30s but there are still some ongoing 500s from stuck aggregator pods. I'm killing the worst offenders to force restart.

simon: Can we also add a fallback in Console that shows cached/simplified tiles instead of blank on 500? Noted as follow-up. For now, please escalate if customers are on SLA.

julie: Thanks — looks like my panels started rendering again around 00:20 UTC. Will monitor and report if it recurs. :thumbsup:

carlos: Logged a high-priority support ticket for affected accounts and sent status update to customers.

anna: Follow-up actions: 1) rollback retention job changes + add resource limits to aggregator pods 2) add backpressure on retention to avoid full-cluster scan during peak queries 3) add alert for rising 5xx rate on analytics query endpoint 4) postmortem if rollback doesn't stick.

simon: I'll create an incident and assign to eng-ml + infra. Incident ID INC-2024-1987. Escalating to paging rule.

cassandra: Thanks everyone. I'll update customers and mark the ticket as "mitigated" for now.

anna: Logs excerpt from aggregator pod before restart: 
```
ERROR runtime: out of memory: failed to allocate 512MB
stack: 
  github.com/redwood/analytics/aggregator.processQuery
  /work/aggregator/query.go:423
  runtime.alloc
```

simon: Perfect — that confirms OOM. We'll add headroom and tune the compaction window. I'll keep thread updated.

carlos: Closing loop with Julie now. If folks see reappearance, ping #eng-oncall.

julie: Appreciate the quick help — panels look stable for me at the moment.

simon: Last note: temporary workaround for customers: narrow time-range or switch to the "low-res" chart option in Console to avoid heavy aggregation. We'll aim for a proper fix in the next deploy.
